findings.title: Correcting a poll question silently deletes every existing vote.
findings.scenario: Tom creates a poll, and Omar and Ali vote. Tom corrects a spelling mistake in the question without changing any choices. Saving the edit deletes both votes without warning.
findings.test_needed: Edit only the question of a poll with existing votes through the web editor; assert option identities and all votes remain unchanged.

owner_question.question: When Tom corrects only a poll question, what should happen to Omar's and Ali's votes?
options: Preserve their votes and the existing choices
Prevent Tom from editing after voting begins
Erase their votes whenever Tom saves an edit (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: The web Hub never loads posts or polls beyond the first 50.
findings.scenario: Tom publishes 51 updates in the pharmacy Hub. Omar can see only the newest 50 because scrolling never requests older updates. Following a notification to the oldest update also fails to reveal it.
findings.test_needed: Populate a Hub with 51 posts and 51 polls; assert Omar can reach both second pages and open a notification targeting the oldest post.

owner_question.question: How should Omar access Tom's updates once the pharmacy Hub contains more than 50 posts?
options: Load older updates as Omar scrolls
Offer pages or a Load more button
Show only the first 50 updates (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: A failed poll save erases the question and choices.
findings.scenario: Tom writes a poll question and five choices, then submits it during a connection failure. The dialog displays an error but clears everything Tom entered. Tom must recreate the poll before retrying.
findings.test_needed: Reject the poll save request and assert the error appears while the original question and every choice remain available for retry.

owner_question.question: When Tom's poll cannot be saved, what should happen to his question and choices?
options: Keep everything in the dialog for retry
Preserve a draft that Tom can reopen
Clear the question and choices (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Comment submissions erase text typed while the earlier comment is sending.
findings.scenario: Omar submits a comment on Tom's post over a slow connection, then starts typing his next comment in the still-editable field. When the first comment finishes sending, Omar's new text disappears. The same loss occurs with post replies and poll comments.
findings.test_needed: Delay a comment response, enter additional text while it is pending, then resolve it; assert the additional text survives for post comments, replies and poll comments.

owner_question.question: While Omar's comment is sending, how should the comment field behave?
options: Allow typing and preserve any newly entered text
Disable editing until the submission finishes
Allow typing but clear it when sending finishes (keep today's behaviour)
